_comment: DM AI OS v1.5.1 — Storage Node Registry. No credentials stored here. Identity resolved by OAuth at runtime (Google Colab drive.mount()).

google-drive-primary.notes: Mounted via official Google Colab OAuth: from google.colab import drive; drive.mount('/content/drive'). No credentials stored in this file.

google-drive-secondary.notes: Optional secondary storage via Drive shortcuts. Shortcuts added manually by user from 'Shared with me'. No automation of credentials.

local-comfyui.notes: Ephemeral Colab runtime NVMe. ~500 MB/s. Cleared on runtime reset. Used as local cache for frequently-used models.
